description: Find apps by name or id in AppGoat's catalog of both stores (~5M apps): exact title matches first, then prefix, then substring, most-rated first. Returns store, app_id, title, developer, category, rating, ratings and price; pass the app_id to the other tools. Cost: 1 credits.

category.description: Store category name, e.g. `Photo & Video` (App Store) or `PHOTOGRAPHY` (Play).

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

q.description: App name (≥ 2 characters) or exact id. Example: photo editor

store.description: Limit to one store: 'apple' or 'play'. Omit for both.

name: search_apps
title: Search Apps
